lesson: Both shorts failed due to aggressive entry into oversold conditions where liquidity sweeps were misinterpreted as bearish continuation rather than reversal triggers. The system is currently failing to distinguish between genuine structural breakdown and localized mean reversion in extreme fear environments.
adjustment: Require a confirmed Market Structure Shift (MSS) on the 1H timeframe following a liquidity sweep before entering any short position on ARBUSDT.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps less on ARBUSDT without a confirmed 1H structural break.
